model: Autobahn ATB2 LED cobra head (ATB2 Autobahn LED Roadway)
notes: Covers the MVOLT (120-277 V) build; the 347 V, 480 V and XVOLT (277-480 V) builds are separate ordering codes and some options, such as PCSS, are not offered on 347 or 480 V. The sheet describes the head as comparable to a 400-1000 W HPS roadway luminaire.

gaps: Surge protection: the features text gives a minimum of 10 kV/5 kA with 20 kV/10 kA also available; the ordering table makes 20 kV/10 kA the standard (blank) code and a 10 kV/5 kA MOV pack the MP option. Both are stated, and they do not contradict each other.
Lumens: the ordering table gives nominal 26,192 to 50,476 per package; the performance table on page 3 shows 21,844 to 53,940 by optic and colour temperature. Lumens are not a rating field.
Driver maker and model are not named on the sheet, so none is claimed.
Voltage is given as the luminaire's ordering option (MVOLT, 347, 480, XVOLT); the sheet does not state it separately for the driver.
The Acuity and AEL product pages returned HTTP 403, so a newer revision than 04/16/24 may exist.
method: Spec sheet 'Autobahn Series ATB2', AEL_0109_ATB2, Rev. 04/16/24 (7 pages), read with node tools/research.js pdf; pages 1 and 2 rendered and checked against the text.
Page 1 (features, weight, EPA), page 2 (ordering table) and page 3 (input watts by package) are used; pages 4-7 (lumen maintenance, BUG ratings, mounting adapters) were read but not used.
The copy is hosted by NCDOT in its product-approval file; the pages carry the AEL logo, the AEL Headquarters address and the Acuity Brands copyright with the revision in the footer.
acuitybrands.com and americanelectriclighting.acuitybrands.com ATB2 pages returned HTTP 403 and were not read.

comps.spec: IP66-rated LED light engines, rated over 100,000 h at 25 C (L70); 4000K standard, or 2700K, 3000K or 5000K, 70 CRI minimum. Input watts run from 175 W (P601) to 369 W (P905) by performance package; the ordering table's nominal lumens run from 26,192 (P601) to 50,476 (P905).
Molded silicone optics in Type II, III, III Long, IV and V roadway distributions; 0% uplight.
Electronic LED driver, 0-10 V dimmable, expected life 100,000 h at 25 C ambient. The luminaire's MVOLT input is 120-277 V; 347 V, 480 V and XVOLT 277-480 V are other ordering options.

Surge protection device: standard is a 20 kV/10 kA SPD (blank ordering code); option MP is a MOV pack rated 10 kV/5 kA. The features text calls 10 kV/5 kA the minimum, with 20 kV/10 kA also available.

Photocontrol receptacle: 3-pin NEMA is standard; 7-pin (P7 option, dimmable driver included) or none (NR) are options. Photocontrol options are PCSS solid-state locking (10-year rated life, 120-277 V) and PCLL solid-state long-life locking (20-year rated life), plus a shorting cap (SH).
Rugged die-cast aluminium housing, polyester powder-coated. Whole luminaire approx. 21 lb (9.53 kg), EPA 0.78 sq ft.
